## OptionalField interface

A record field that may be absent, made with [ValueTypeConstructors.optional()](./contracts.valuetypeconstructors.optional.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface OptionalField<Sdk>
```

## Remarks

This is a field marker, not a value type: it is meaningful only as a field of [ValueTypeConstructors.record()](./contracts.valuetypeconstructors.record.md)<!-- -->. Presence and nullability are separate axes, so an optional field may also be nullable (`t.optional(t.nullable(…))`<!-- -->).
